notes.harambee: Okusorooza, collecting money together for a cause.

guidebook.intro: Follow the news, share opinions and say what others said. Ngu introduces reported speech.

tips.title: Saying what others said: ngu
body: **Ngu** is “that” after verbs of saying and thinking: **Naagira ngu naaija** (he says that he’s coming), **Nibagira ngu enjura neeija** (they say that rain is coming), **Nimbona ngu ni kikuru** (I think that it’s important).
**-gira** (say) is used for reporting; **-gamba** (speak, talk) for speaking itself.

culture.title: Radio
body: Radio is how most people get the news, and local stations broadcast in Runyankore-Rukiga. Call-in shows let listeners share their views on community issues.
